🎬 Crashing Through the Snow (2021)

Crashing Through the Snow follows Maggie Collins, a divorced mother who accepts an invitation to spend Christmas in Aspen with her daughters, ex-husband, and his new girlfriend, Kate. Feeling overshadowed by Kate’s seemingly perfect holiday plans, Maggie struggles to find her place within their changing family dynamic. Things take an unexpected turn when she meets Kate’s charming brother, Sam, who encourages her to create unforgettable Christmas memories of her own. As the two spend more time together, an unexpected romantic connection begins to develop. Starring Amy Acker and Warren Christie, the film combines festive romance, lighthearted comedy, and heartwarming storytelling while exploring blended families, second chances, personal growth, and the importance of embracing new beginnings during the holiday season.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Comedy • Christmas

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 24m • TV-G

🎥 Director: Rich Newey

✍️ Writer: Tamar Laddy

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hallmark+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current availability in the United States.
